All 34 recordings are embedded in this page. Click to test your speakers.

Reject a clip if any word is missing or added, punctuation/IPA is read aloud, c/g is softened, v sounds like English v, gn becomes ny, stress or vowel length is wrong, or there are clicks, hiss, clipping, breath noises, irregular speed/volume, or over 0.3 seconds of leading/trailing silence.

House convention: no elision; final -m lightly audible; hic est may sound like hik-kest or hik est. A button marked Accept indicates only your listening judgment; audio is not installed in the Latin reader. Exported review JSON is your approval record.
